questions.q: To which church is this letter written?
From what did the Thessalonians turn to God?
questions.x: To serve the living and true God, and to wait for his Son from heaven.

questions.q: How does Paul say he was gentle among them?
questions.a: Even as a nurse cherisheth her children
w: As a king with his servants
As a soldier with his captain
As a judge in the gate

questions.q: Whom did Paul send from Athens to establish them?
What is the will of God, says 1 Thessalonians 4:3?
Put the Lord's coming in the order Paul gives it.
items: The Lord descends from heaven with a shout
The dead in Christ rise first
We which are alive are caught up
So shall we ever be with the Lord

questions.q: How does the day of the Lord come?
questions.a: As a thief in the night
acc: as a thief in the night
